mismatch.message: The visible prisoner does not speak or leave its waiting strategy when its first allocated action occurs.

summary: The admitted v75 recording reaches C quest.c:prisoner_speaks through quest_talk's MS_DJINNI arm when the nearby peaceful prisoner still has STRAT_WAITMASK. JavaScript quest_talk currently calls note_unported('quest.c prisoner_speaks'), omitting the speech, release transition, peaceful state, alignment adjustment, and angry_guards call. The saved trace matches through step 129; C speaks at step 130. A separate movement RNG divergence begins at step 133 and is not attributed to this missing speech branch.

source.branch: For an MS_DJINNI monster whose species is PM_PRISONER and whose mstrategy intersects STRAT_WAITMASK, prisoner_speaks emits the visible speech line when canseemon is true, verbalizes the release message, clears STRAT_WAITMASK, sets mpeaceful, adjusts alignment by 3, then calls angry_guards(FALSE).
callers: monmove.c:dochug wait-mask branch, after the STRAT_CLOSE, awake, and monnear gates (720-722), calls quest_talk
monmove.c:dochug ordinary post-action quest speech branch calls quest_talk when !helpless(mtmp) && nearby (981)
findings: quest.c:451-468 gates the behavior on both exact prisoner species identity and STRAT_WAITMASK; the branch then performs ordered speech, wait-mask clearing, peaceful-state mutation, alignment adjustment, and guard anger.
quest.c:495-511 dispatches MS_DJINNI to prisoner_speaks and discards its void result.
The normal-level recipe uses wizard genesis to create an ordinary peaceful prisoner; its M3_CLOSE behavior supplies STRAT_CLOSE/STRAT_WAITMASK without injected game state.

The admitted evaluation records 134/195 matching screens, 2353/2376 RNG calls, and 195/195 cursors. Its first screen mismatch is step 130, where C shows the prisoner speaking the finally-free line; the first later RNG mismatch is step 133 and is outside the missing speech dispatch itself.

js/quest.js:445-459 already implements the quest_talk dispatcher for leader and nemesis branches, but the MS_DJINNI branch records note_unported('quest.c prisoner_speaks') instead of reproducing the C side effects.
In this recorder build, include/sndprocs.h:276 defines SetVoice as an empty macro, so no JavaScript sound call is needed.

evidence: Read upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/quest.c:451-468 and 495-511; prisoner_speaks is called only for MS_DJINNI from quest_talk and its void result is discarded.
Read upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/monmove.c:720-722 and 981; the recording reaches the waiting-prisoner caller after STRAT_CLOSE, awake, and proximity gates.
Read upstream nethack-c/upstream/include/sndprocs.h:276; SetVoice compiles to a no-op in this recorder configuration.
Read js/quest.js:445-459; the existing MS_DJINNI arm calls note_unported('quest.c prisoner_speaks').

The v75 recipe and recording establish the normal-level wizard-genesis prisoner setup and first speech at step 130. The official v75 evaluation reports 134/195 screens, 2353/2376 RNG calls, and 195/195 cursors; the saved matching prefix ends at step 129.
